refined_summary: Search discovery confirms a high-value revision trajectory: FORWARD I reported on 2019-03-01 that it did not meet its primary PFS endpoint; later development concentrated on FRalpha-high disease using PS2+ scoring, FDA granted accelerated approval on 2022-11-14 with an FDA-approved FOLR1 companion diagnostic, FDA converted the indication to regular approval on 2024-03-22 based on MIRASOL, and AbbVie completed its ImmunoGen acquisition on 2024-02-12. The tempting causal story that 'fixing the assay caused success' remains a hypothesis: later studies also changed population/design and must be compared explicitly.
source_origin_notes: The 2019 ImmunoGen release is now hosted on AbbVie's news archive after acquisition; treat corporate archive/reposts as one upstream corporate-origin cluster.
FDA approval pages are regulator-origin and independent of sponsor press material.
ClinicalTrials.gov records are authoritative registry records but many fields are sponsor-submitted and should not be treated as independent corroboration of sponsor claims.
refined_queries: FORWARD I mirvetuximab 2019 primary endpoint PFS
FDA Elahere 2022 accelerated approval companion diagnostic
FORWARD I retrospective rescore limitations assay versus population statistical design
what_counts_as_support: A contemporaneous FORWARD I source showing the failed primary endpoint and the then-current interpretation.
A dated sponsor/SEC/protocol source documenting the scoring-method change and intended FRalpha-high selection before later success was known.
Regulator/trial records establishing the 2022 accelerated and 2024 regular approval states and their evidence bases.
what_counts_as_contradiction: Evidence that FORWARD I actually met its prespecified primary endpoint.
Evidence that later registrational trials used materially the same biomarker selection and population as FORWARD I, undermining the remembered selection-revision arc.
Evidence that the assay/scoring explanation appeared only retrospectively and was not a contemporaneous development rationale; if so, classify it as later explanation rather than historical Judgment.
unresolved_questions: Exactly when did ImmunoGen publicly commit to PS2+ >=75% as the registrational population?
Which changes besides assay/scoring—line of therapy, prior bevacizumab, statistical design, sample size—must be separated from biomarker refinement?
What contemporaneous analyst/company expectations existed immediately after FORWARD I failure and before SORAYA/MIRASOL success?
delegated_evidence_instructions: Archive claim-scoped originals for FORWARD I failure, scoring-method revision, SORAYA/MIRASOL design and readouts, 2022/2024 FDA states, and AbbVie acquisition. Build snapshots at 2019 failure, post-revision pre-success, 2022 accelerated approval, and 2024 regular approval/acquisition. Keep later causal explanations out of earlier Judgment unless they were actually knowable then.
